title: 第9章 许明渊的选择第10章 合作
content_zh:
;;
“这个行吗？我阿爹那本事........”
大牛都不想说下去。
干啥啥不行，家里干饭第一名。
也怪不得他大伯都有些瞧不上他阿爹。
“我阿爹说过，天生我材必有用，每个人都有自己擅长的，要因利势导。”
“他曾告诉我一个故事，那个故事的主人公跟二苟叔一样，普通人一个，但后面走上经商之路。
从此发迹，成为南方郡城有名的大富商，即便郡城官老爷对其也都是客客气气。”
“这个故事叫什么？”
“陈二苟的妖孽人生！”
闻言，几人顿时沉默。
许明渊笑着继续道：“洞溪村，跟我爹最要好的就是二苟叔了。”
“你回去让二苟叔放弃种青玉梨，跟着我阿爹干。”
“你们可以请人种植，让我阿爹指导，种出的瓜果蔬菜，我们两家一起卖，不过我阿爹心思不在经商上，估计会由二苟叔来做。”
“至于利润，我觉得七三分合适，我家七，你家三。”
“为什么是七三？”
许明巍忽然插嘴，他十分的好奇，自己弟弟是怎么得出这个比例的。
“是啊，既然川伯和我阿爹都是好兄弟，怎么不是五五，或者按照各家提供的多寡来分。”
大牛学堂上了几年，也不再是懵懂的稚童。
许明渊呵呵一笑，开始解释起来，“首先，二苟叔如果要种好瓜果蔬菜，不请我阿爹，是不是也要请擅长此道的人，你说这要不要花钱？”

“如果随便种种，你看洞溪村有哪家哪户种瓜果蔬菜能赚钱的，不亏就已经很好了吧。”
“我阿爹和二苟叔虽然是好兄弟，但亲兄弟也明算账，你大伯也不会无缘无故接济你家，不是吗？”
“我阿爹是十里八乡都有名的农户，请他能便宜？”
“如果是偶尔指点一下，那没关系，但如果经常性的，我阿爹也很忙的。”
许明渊不停说着，陈大牛则频频点头，觉得他说得十分在理。
“第二，两家的产品一起卖，先不说你家最终种出来的如何，至少我家的瓜果蔬菜已经打出了名气，别说洞溪村的都喜欢优先买我家的，就算放在十里八乡也是如此。”
“阿爹跟我说过一个词，那就是招牌效应。”
“就好比县城中一些百年老字号的药材铺，首饰店，你阿爹和阿娘如果去县城，是不是第一选择是他们家。”
“光顾的人多了，利润自然高。”
“你家自己单独卖，你可以算算最终能有多少。”
“当然，也有另一种合作方式，那就是分开来卖，我家农田里产的瓜果蔬菜，卖出去收益都归我们，而你家的同样可以用我阿爹的名气。”
“利润可以三七或者二八。”
许明巍看得眼睛顿时亮了起来，这个方法可谓是合作双赢。
既帮了二苟叔家，又让自家额外多了一笔收益。
毕竟二苟叔家论人脉比自家是要多出不少，有阿爹的指导，至少品质不会太差，规模再上去，每年的利润估计也十分可观。
许川站在厅堂门口，听到许明渊的观点，都是十分诧异。
虽然自己也有过指点，但七岁的孩童能理解到这种程度，并想出这样的合作方式，绝对是天赋异禀。
“【生财有道】，这天赋看来非他莫属了。”
许川微微一笑，心中也做出了决定。
陈芳芳眼睛里放光，一脸崇拜地看向许明渊，“阿渊，你太聪明了。”

“我这就回去把这个主意告诉我阿爹和阿娘。”
陈大牛也当即跟陈芳芳回去。
“阿渊，过来。”许川突然开口。
两人转头看去，然后齐声道：“阿爹。”
许明渊走上前去，好奇问道：“什么事，阿爹。”

"Is this okay? My father's ability..."
Daniel didn’t even want to say any more.
No matter what he does, he is the first in the family to cook.
No wonder his uncle looked down upon his father.
"My father once said that the talents we are born with will be useful. Everyone has their own strengths, and we must take advantage of the situation."
"He once told me a story. The protagonist of that story was just like Uncle Ergou. He was an ordinary person, but he later embarked on the road of business.
From then on, he became prosperous and became a well-known wealthy businessman in the southern county. Even the county officials were polite to him. "
"What's the name of this story?"
"Chen Ergou's evil life!"
Hearing this, several people fell silent.
Xu Mingyuan smiled and continued: "In Dongxi Village, my father's best friend is Uncle Ergou."
"You go back and ask Uncle Ergou to give up growing green jade pears and follow my father."
"You can hire someone to plant it and let my father guide you. Our two families will sell the fruits and vegetables they grow together. However, my father is not interested in doing business. I think Uncle Ergou will do the work."
"As for the profit, I think seventy-three is appropriate, seven for my family and three for your family."
"Why Qi San?"
Xu Mingwei suddenly interrupted. He was very curious as to how his brother came up with this ratio.
"Yes, since Uncle Chuan and my father are both good brothers, why not divide it 50-50, or according to the amount provided by each family."
After attending Daniu Academy for several years, I am no longer an ignorant child.
Xu Mingyuan chuckled and began to explain, "First of all, if Uncle Ergou wants to grow good fruits and vegetables, instead of hiring my dad, he should also hire someone who is good at this. Do you think it will cost money?"
"If you just grow it casually, look at any household in Dongxi Village that can make money growing fruits and vegetables. If you don't lose money, it's already good."
"Although my father and Uncle Ergou are good brothers, they are also brothers who have settled accounts. Your uncle will not help your family for no reason, right?"
"My father is a famous farmer from all over the country. Is it cheaper to hire him?"
"If it's an occasional pointer, that's okay, but if it's regular, my dad is also very busy."
Xu Mingyuan kept talking, while Chen Daniu nodded frequently, feeling that what he said was very reasonable.
"Second, the products of both companies are sold together. Let's not talk about how your family will grow in the end. At least my fruits and vegetables have already gained a reputation. Not to mention that people in Dongxi Village like to buy my products first, even if they are placed in ten miles and eight towns."
"My father once told me a word, and that is the signature effect."
"Just like some century-old medicine shops and jewelry stores in the county town. If your father and mother-in-law go to the county town, their first choice will be theirs."
“The more people come, the higher the profits will be.”
"If you sell your home individually, you can calculate how much you can end up with."
"Of course, there is another way of cooperation, which is to sell them separately. All the profits from the fruits and vegetables produced in my farmland belong to us, and yours can also use my father's reputation."
"The profit can be thirty-seven or twenty-eight."
Xu Mingwei's eyes suddenly lit up. This method can be described as a win-win cooperation.
It not only helped Uncle Ergou's family, but also gave me an extra income.
After all, Uncle Ergou's family has a lot more connections than our own. With Dad's guidance, at least the quality will not be too bad. As the scale increases, the annual profits are expected to be very considerable.
Xu Chuan stood at the door of the hall and was very surprised when he heard Xu Mingyuan's point of view.
Although I have given some guidance, it is definitely a gift for a seven-year-old child to understand it to this extent and come up with such a way of cooperation.
"[The right way to make money], this talent seems to belong to him."
Xu Chuan smiled slightly and made a decision in his heart.
Chen Fangfang's eyes shone and she looked at Xu Mingyuan with admiration, "Ayuan, you are so smart."
"I'll go back right nowThis idea came to my father and mother-in-law. "
Chen Daniu also immediately went back with Chen Fangfang.
"Ayuan, come here. "Xu Chuan suddenly spoke.
The two turned to look, and then said in unison: "Dad. "
Xu Mingyuan stepped forward and asked curiously: "What's the matter, Dad. "
